decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise access.
decisions.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or verify hotel properties with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise access before recommending or booking.
decisions.exception_condition: If a current trip prioritizes another tradeoff or a property lacks one of these amenities, ask whether a close substitute or omission is acceptable.
decisions.name: prefer_hotel_pool_hot_tub_fitness
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise access.
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples support a recurring hotel amenity preference for pool, hot tub, and exercise access. Wording varies between must-have and preference, so keep it as a soft default that verifies or prioritizes these amenities without inferring unrelated amenities or trip details.

decisions.boundary_condition: Use this as a soft included-service preference. Do not infer breakfast quality, full breakfast, destination, dates, price, room setup, or other amenities from this habit.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.condition: When searching for, evaluating, or choosing a hotel.
decisions.default_action: Favor hotels that advertise free breakfast when otherwise suitable options are available; verify availability if breakfast inclusion is unclear.
decisions.exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable hotel includes free breakfast, or if the current request treats breakfast only tentatively, ask whether a hotel without free breakfast is acceptable rather than rejecting good options outright.
decisions.name: prefer_included_hotel_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: The examples show repeated interest in hotels with free breakfast, though one mention is tentative and one is phrased as a question. Keep as a soft hotel-selection default rather than a hard requirement.
